justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/time/FastDateParser.java (NumberStrategy at lines 245-325 and its uses at lines 655-713). NumberStrategy is a private nested helper with one field (`field`) and a single cohesive responsibility: parsing numeric calendar fields. It has only four small methods/overrides (`isNumber`, `modify`, `parse`, `toString`), and the field-specific variants are just anonymous subclasses overriding `modify` for minor adjustments, not separate responsibilities. No evidence of excessive size, many public methods, or low cohesion.
